rows.name: Steakhouse Financial
farm_steps: Use a fresh wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, and keep its seed phrase offline. A separate wallet keeps the farm's transactions apart from your main funds, so any snapshot reads one clean history. Cost: under $1 of gas for the first transaction. Time: 5 minutes.

Deposit $150 into a Steakhouse Financial vault on Solana and keep the shares — vault shares accrue value, so the deposit itself is the position. Cost: $150 of capital and about $0.01 of gas for the deposit transaction. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Make one qualifying action each week for four weeks, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote. Repeated actions across weeks put the wallet in more than one snapshot window instead of a single day. Cost: about $0.01 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days before you touch it. A position that survives 30 days is counted in more than one snapshot, while a same-day in-and-out leaves almost nothing to read. Cost: the $150 stays in the position and remains withdrawable. Time: 30 days.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own rewards page from the link it publishes and check whether anything is claimable. Checking first means you never pay a claim fee for nothing, and you never follow a link a stranger sent you. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.

Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction hash in a farm log. The log is what lets you repeat the position on the next protocol or unwind this one without guessing. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Net: $0.07 gas total (7 transactions on Solana at about $0.01 each) + $150 capital locked, withdrawable + about 45 minutes of setup and weekly actions, hold 30 days. Only the gas is spent; the capital comes back when you withdraw.

Provide $50 of liquidity to Origami Finance's main pool on Plasma and keep the position open — pooled depth is the activity a DEX snapshot can see. Cost: $50 of capital and about $0.02 of gas for the deposit transaction. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Make one qualifying action each week for four weeks, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote. Repeated actions across weeks put the wallet in more than one snapshot window instead of a single day. Cost: about $0.02 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days before you touch it. A position that survives 30 days is counted in more than one snapshot, while a same-day in-and-out leaves almost nothing to read. Cost: the $50 stays in the position and remains withdrawable. Time: 30 days.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own rewards page from the link it publishes and check whether anything is claimable. Checking first means you never pay a claim fee for nothing, and you never follow a link a stranger sent you. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.

Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction hash in a farm log. The log is what lets you repeat the position on the next protocol or unwind this one without guessing. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Net: $0.14 gas total (7 transactions on Plasma at about $0.02 each) + $50 capital locked, withdrawable + about 45 minutes of setup and weekly actions, hold 30 days. Only the gas is spent; the capital comes back when you withdraw.

Provide $50 of liquidity to SyncSwap's main pool on Linea and keep the position open — pooled depth is the activity a DEX snapshot can see. Cost: $50 of capital and about $0.03 of gas for the deposit transaction. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Make one qualifying action each week for four weeks, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote. Repeated actions across weeks put the wallet in more than one snapshot window instead of a single day. Cost: about $0.03 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days before you touch it. A position that survives 30 days is counted in more than one snapshot, while a same-day in-and-out leaves almost nothing to read. Cost: the $50 stays in the position and remains withdrawable. Time: 30 days.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own rewards page from the link it publishes and check whether anything is claimable. Checking first means you never pay a claim fee for nothing, and you never follow a link a stranger sent you. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.

Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction hash in a farm log. The log is what lets you repeat the position on the next protocol or unwind this one without guessing. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Net: $0.21 gas total (7 transactions on Linea at about $0.03 each) + $50 capital locked, withdrawable + about 45 minutes of setup and weekly actions, hold 30 days. Only the gas is spent; the capital comes back when you withdraw.

Deposit $50 of USDC as margin on TurboFlow Perps and open one small hedged trade — margin on the books is what a perps snapshot counts. Cost: $50 of capital and about $0.01 of gas for the deposit transaction. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Make one qualifying action each week for four weeks, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote. Repeated actions across weeks put the wallet in more than one snapshot window instead of a single day. Cost: about $0.01 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days before you touch it. A position that survives 30 days is counted in more than one snapshot, while a same-day in-and-out leaves almost nothing to read. Cost: the $50 stays in the position and remains withdrawable. Time: 30 days.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own rewards page from the link it publishes and check whether anything is claimable. Checking first means you never pay a claim fee for nothing, and you never follow a link a stranger sent you. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.

Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction hash in a farm log. The log is what lets you repeat the position on the next protocol or unwind this one without guessing. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Net: $0.07 gas total (7 transactions on Solana at about $0.01 each) + $50 capital locked, withdrawable + about 45 minutes of setup and weekly actions, hold 30 days. Only the gas is spent; the capital comes back when you withdraw.
